desc: The Zastava M91 Sniper rifle is chambered in the 7.62x54R round and based on the well-known Kalashnikov operating system. It is designed for police and military applications and used worldwide. The rifle provides exceptional precision at long distances and preforms in extreme environments. The M91 has gas regulator enables the weapon to be used in tough conditions and ensure reliability. The stock provides adjustment and allows for the shooter to get a comfortable position for long range shooting.
